message: Ad-hoc `opencode run` MUST close/redirect stdin (`</dev/null`) — omitting it can hang indefinitely at 0% CPU with zero output.

Always pass `-m <provider/model>` to a non-interactive `opencode run`. When the configured default provider is out of quota, opencode retries the 429 indefinitely and produces NO output — indistinguishable from a deadlock. Confirm with `--print-logs --log-level debug` (look for 'stream error … Error 429').
OpenCode v2 `run` does not expand slash-command prompts. Send them via `session.command` (POST /api/session/{id}/command).
`--share` publishes nothing: OpenCode `run` has no such flag. Drop it.
